import json
def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # separator color: color forming full rows/cols
    sc=None
    for c in range(10):
        if any(all(v==c for v in r_) for r_ in inp) or any(all(v==c for v in col) for col in zip(*inp)):
            sc=c; break
    rows=[]
    i=0
    while i<H:
        # find run of non-separator rows
        j=i
        while j<H and inp[j][0]!=sc: j+=1
        rows.append((i,j)); i=j
    cols=[]
    i=0
    while i<W:
        j=i
        while j<W and all(inp[r_][j]!=sc for r_ in range(H)): j+=1
        cols.append((i,j)); i=j
    # cells grid
    bands=[]
    for (a,b) in rows: bands.append((a,b,H-len(rows[-1]) if False else None))
    # simpler: band = consecutive rows between separator rows
    seprows=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==sc for v in inp[r])]
    bands=[]; prev=0
    for s in seprows+[H]:
        if s>prev: bands.append((prev,s)); prev=s+1
    seprcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r_][c]==sc for r_ in range(H))]
    cellcols=[]; prev=0
    for s in seprcols+[W]:
        if s>prev: cellcols.append((prev,s)); prev=s+1
    # patterns per (band, cell)
    pat={}
    for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(bands):
        for ci,(c,d) in enumerate(cellcols):
            cells=[(r-a,k-c) for r in range(a,b) for k in range(c,d) if inp[r][k] not in (0,sc)]
            if cells:
                col=inp[a+cells[0][0]][c+cells[0][1]]
                pat[(bi,ci)]=(col,cells)
    # largest pattern globally -> template mask
    sizes=[len(v[1]) for v in pat.values()]
    mx=max(sizes)
    tmpl=None
    if sizes.count(mx)==1:
        key=min((k for k,v in pat.items() if len(v[1])==mx))
        tmpl={(r,c) for r,c in pat[key][1]}
    else:
        tmpl={ (0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1)}
    out=[[sc if (r in seprows or c in seprcols) else 0 for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(bands):
        cols_=cellcols
        firstcol=None
        for ci,(c,d) in enumerate(cellcols):
            cells=pat.get((bi,ci))
            col=inp[a+cells[0][0]][c+cells[1]if False else 0]
            firstcol=col
            for (r_,k_) in tmpl:
                out[a+r_][c+k_]=col
    return out

import numpy as np
ti=np.array(G['Test input'])
# separators: rows/cols that are entirely 5
srows=[i for i,r in enumerate(ti) if (r==5).all()]
scols=[c for c in range(24) if (ti[:,c]==5).all()]
print(srows,scols)
# block grid
rbnds=[]; r=0
while r<24:
    if r not in srows:
        e=r
        while e<24 and e not in srows: e+=1
        rbnds.append((r,e-1)); r=e
    else: r+=1
cbnds=[]; c=0
while c<24:
    if c not in scol:
        e=c
        while e<24 and e not in scol: e+=1
        cbnds.append((c,e-1)); c=e
    else: c+=1
print(rbnds,cbnds)
# find the template block: the one whose cells are not a single color
templ=None; pos=None
for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(rbnds):
    for cj,(x,y) in enumerate(cbnds):
        sub=ti[a:b+1,x:y+1]
        nz=set(sub.flatten())-{5}
        if len(nz)>1 or (len(nz)==1 and nz.pop()!=sub[0,0] and True):
            pass
# simpler: block is template if not uniform color
for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(rbnds):
    for cj,(x,y) in enumerate(cbnds):
        sub=ti[a:b+1,x:y+1]
        u=set(sub.flatten())
        if len(u)>1:  # contains multiple colors -> template
            templ=sub.tolist(); pos=(bi,cj)
print('template at',pos); print(templ)

import json,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

divcols=[c for c in range(24) if all(row[c]==row[0] and row[c]!=0 for row in T)]
print('div rows',divrows,'div cols',divcols)

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
T=G['Test input']
def tiles(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    divr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(I[r]))==1 and I[r][0]!=0]
    dset=set(divr)
    divc=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==I[0][c] and I[0][c]!=0 and r not in dset for r in range(H))]
    rb=[];p=0
    for r in sorted(divr)+[H]:
        if r>p: rb.append((p,r)); p=r+1
    cb=[];p=0
    for c in sorted(divc)+[W]:
        if c>p: cb.append((p,c)); p=c+1
    return rb,cb
def glyphs(I,rb,cb):
    # per band: list of (color,cells) with cells relative to tile origin
    out=[]
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        g=[]
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            cs=[(r-r0,c-c0,I[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=I[r0][c0]]
            if not cs: continue
            col=cs[0][2]
            cc=[(a,b,v) for a,b,v in cs if v==col]
            g.append((col,cc,len(cc)))
        out.append(g)
    return out
def f(I):
    rb,cb=tiles(I)
    O_=I
    for bidx,(glist) in enumerate(glyphs(I,rb,cb)):
        # pick largest glyph (by cell count); tie -> any
        sel=max(glist,key=lambda g:g[2])
        col,cells,_=sel
        # repaint color to the other color present in band, else keep
        cols={g[0] for g in glist}
        rep=col if len(cols)==1 else [c for c in cols if c!=col][0]
        for (r0,r1) in rb:
            for (c0,c1) in cb:
                for dr,dc,v in cells:
                    O_[r0+dr][c0+dc]=v
    return O_
print(f(I)==O)
R=f(T)
for r in R: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(R))

def analyze(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    divr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(I[r]))==1 and I[r][0]!=0]
    divc=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==I[0][c] and I[0][c]!=0 for r in range(H))]
    rb=[];prev=0
    for d in divr+[H]:
        if d>prev: rb.append((prev,d)); prev=d+1
    cb=[];prev=0
    for d in divc+[W]:
        if d>prev: cb.append((prev,d)); prev=d+1
    print('divr',divr,'divc',divc,'rb',rb,'cb',cb)
    return divr,divc,rb,cb
analyze(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
